name: Royal LeBlanc
source:
The butler of the d'Lockes family, brought into the role at a young age when his acting father died a tragic death. Beneath a gruff exterior of sarcasm and glares is a knightly soul, yet Royal's heart seems untouchable. What scars is this grumpy guy concealing?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36483]Lemmasoft[/url]]
